description: This file implements logging verbosity control for Kubernetes, including support for -v and -vmodule flags, managing verbosity levels, file pattern matching, and thread-safe state management.

classes.name: VState
classes.description: Contains thread-safe logging verbosity and module filter state, including mutexes, atomic counters, and maps for managing log levels.

classes.name: levelSpec
classes.description: Represents the verbosity level with atomic support, providing get/set and string conversion.

classes.name: moduleSpec
classes.description: Holds the configuration for the -vmodule flag, including filter patterns.

classes.name: modulePat
classes.description: Defines a pattern and level for vmodule filtering, with matching logic.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current verbosity level atomically.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of the level.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns the verbosity level as an interface{}.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the type name 'Level' for flag parsing.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses and sets the verbosity level from a string.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns string representation of the moduleSpec.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns nil, as moduleSpec is not exported.

methods.name: Type
methods.description: Returns the string 'pattern=N,...' for flag parsing.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if a filename matches the pattern, using literal comparison or filepath.Match.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Parses and sets the vmodule filter patterns from a comma-separated string.

methods.name: isLiteral
methods.description: Determines if a pattern is a literal string without metacharacters.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a consistent logging state with new level and filter, updating internal maps and counters.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks if logging is enabled at a given level, considering global verbosity and vmodule filters.

methods.name: setV
methods.description: Computes and caches the log level for a specific program counter, matching filename patterns.
